'''Sarchen Snyle''' was an [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs]] agent who worked at the [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal]] [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He, along with [[Morrina Reugus]], a starport traffic controller, was sympathetic to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and regularly overlooked cargoes bound for Alliance bases.
